Ad blocker fixture page

Companion for test/manual-checklist.md. Open DevTools > Network and watch request statuses: blocked requests report net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT / (blocked:…); non-blocked failures (DNS/404) look different — that distinction is what we test.

Use this button for the “Immediate Effect Both Ways Without Page Reload” checks: toggle the popup, press the button, compare results — no reload needed.
